answer: Require each agent to stake coins that vest only after a history of verified work, like a raven that must return to the same mesa nest season after season. A newcomer earns a lantern of reputation only by completing costly, checkable tasks whose results peers can audit; creating a second identity means funding another full stake and redoing that slow work. Sybil farming then costs real capital and time per identity, while honest agents keep one cheap, long-lived identity.
